title: T1584.006 — Compromise Infrastructure - Web Services
subtitle: Watch an attacker steal a developer account, turn it into a dead-drop resolver for malware inside a company, and see what the SOC notices at the same time.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker steals a developer account on a popular web service, uses it as a dead-drop resolver to task malware on a workstation, and a SOC detects the pattern, blocks the account endpoints, and files an abuse report. A written step-by-step version follows below.
